origin: Named after research published in 1954 by the American psychologist Paul Fitts, an aviation psychologist who studied cockpit controls for the US Air Force.
whenToUse: You set the size and position of main buttons, such as pay or send.
You consider the area the thumb reaches on mobile.
You enlarge the touch area of small icon buttons.
whenNotToUse: You'd make risky buttons such as delete large and close.
You'd make every button large until the hierarchy disappears.
You'd push them against the screen edge where they clash with other gestures.

alternatives.name: Sticky Action Bar
alternatives.reason: Fixing the main action at the bottom.

accessibility: Touch areas are at least 24px, with 44px or more recommended (WCAG 2.5.8).
Don't use small text links for main actions.
Leave space between buttons to prevent mis-taps.
